color_story: A single terracotta-rust drench for a mountain championship in late September, with one marigold spark for the under-par figures; the mandate's 15–40° target necessarily sits near the recently-used 28° orange, so the hue is pushed to the 18° brick edge and rendered as a low-lightness single-hue flood, a different formula and lightness than 09-16's bright navy/orange duotone.
